tooltip.draxatomic.slime_sword.1: A blade of black slime brimming with magical power.
message.draxatomic.no_power: Not enough magical power: you need %s.
tooltip.draxatomic.slime_sword.help.whip: Right-click: the blade stretches and strikes everything in a line.
tooltip.draxatomic.slime_sword.help.dash: Right-click: dash forward, cutting through everything in your path.
tooltip.draxatomic.slime_sword.help.blad: Right-click where you look: slime needles rain down.
tooltip.draxatomic.slime_sword.help.atom: Hold right-click to charge the atomic blast.
tooltip.draxatomic.slime_boots: No fall damage. Jump mid-air for a double jump (5 power).
tooltip.draxatomic.slime_suit.piece: +%s max magical power and +1 regen per second.
tooltip.draxatomic.slime_suit.set: Full set: double regen; while sneaking, distant monsters lose your trail.
tooltip.draxatomic.shadow_emblem.help: Right-click the ground to summon her. Right-click her: follow / stay.
message.draxatomic.ally_fell: %s has fallen. Her emblem lies on the ground.
message.draxatomic.seal_day: The seal only answers at night.
tooltip.draxatomic.diablos_seal: Right-click the ground at night to summon a Knight of the Round Table.
tooltip.draxatomic.diablos_heart: Use it to gain +%s max magical power permanently.
message.draxatomic.knight_arrives: A Knight of the Round Table of the Cult of Diablos has arrived.
message.draxatomic.knight_awakens: "You think that is enough?" The knight awakens his true power.
message.draxatomic.knight_defeated: The Knight of the Round Table has fallen.
tooltip.draxatomic.slime_sword.help.all_: Hold right-click: mark every nearby enemy and drop an Atomic on each one.
tooltip.draxatomic.slime_sword.help.reco: Hold right-click: a sphere of light fully heals you and your allies.
tooltip.draxatomic.mitsugoshi_chocolate: Speed II and regeneration. A favorite of the nobility.
tooltip.draxatomic.mitsugoshi_coffee: Haste II and night vision for 2 minutes.
tooltip.draxatomic.mitsugoshi_shampoo: Clears negative effects and grants luck. Shine guaranteed.
message.draxatomic.command.creative: This command only works in creative mode.
message.draxatomic.city_found: %s is at X %s, Z %s (%s blocks away). Built: %s/%s blocks.
dialog.draxatomic.alexia.greet: So you wander around the castle too... Since you're here, make yourself useful.
dialog.draxatomic.iris.greet: The Crimson Order always needs willing swords. Will you help us protect Midgar?
dialog.draxatomic.claire.greet: Have you seen my brother? He always vanishes when there's trouble... Well, since you're here, train with me.
dialog.draxatomic.gamma.greet: Welcome to Mitsugoshi. Everything we sell comes from our master's knowledge. Here to do business?
dialog.draxatomic.rose.greet: Oriana is the country of arts, but art does not defend itself. I need your help.
dialog.draxatomic.raphael.greet: The Cult has bled my kingdom dry for years. Whoever helps free us will be rewarded.
quest.draxatomic.alexia_cleanup.text: Diablos cultists are hiding around the city. Find them before the guard does.
quest.draxatomic.alexia_round_knight: A Knight of the Round Table
quest.draxatomic.alexia_round_knight.tex: Use a Diablos Seal at night and defeat whatever appears.
quest.draxatomic.iris_crimson_order.text: The roads around the capital aren't safe. Slay the monsters.
quest.draxatomic.iris_supplies.text: Our knights need iron for their weapons.
quest.draxatomic.claire_training.text: Show me you can handle a sword. Skeletons make good opponents.
quest.draxatomic.claire_brother.text: They say the cultists carry something that might explain where he goes... Bring it to me.
quest.draxatomic.gamma_cocoa.text: Mitsugoshi chocolate sells faster than we can make it.
quest.draxatomic.gamma_expansion.text: We're opening a new branch. We need gold.
quest.draxatomic.gamma_research.text: Diablos Drops are dangerous. Bring them so we can study them.
quest.draxatomic.rose_wedding.text: A Knight of the Round Table is behind it all. Defeat him.
quest.draxatomic.raphael_tribute.text: Recover the Diablos Drops the Cult took from Oriana.
quest.draxatomic.list_empty: You have no quests in progress.
spell.draxatomic.shadow_step.desc: Reappear up to 10 blocks ahead, cutting through enemies.
spell.draxatomic.projection.desc: A piercing beam of power. With compression ≥2 it explodes at the end.
spell.draxatomic.counter.desc: For 0.7 s, the next melee hit is returned to the attacker, doubled.
spell.draxatomic.slime_platform.desc: A 5×5 floor under your feet for 8 seconds.
spell.draxatomic.slime_forge.desc: Repair your gear with power (1 power = 2 durability).
spell.draxatomic.summon_garden.desc: Your Shadow Garden members appear at your side.
spell.draxatomic.slime_armor.desc: Sustained: power absorbs damage (4 per point). Breaks when empty.
spell.draxatomic.shadow_stealth.desc: Sustained: invisible, monsters lose your trail. 3 power per second.
spell.draxatomic.conceal.desc: Sustained: monsters more than 10 blocks away lose you if you're not fighting.
spell.draxatomic.awakening.desc: Sustained, with a nearly full bar: more strength, speed and damage; everything costs half. Drains 5%/s.
spell.draxatomic.overload.desc: Sustained: if power runs short, pay the rest with health (5 power = 1 health).
upgrade.draxatomic.compression.desc: +1 max compression level and faster compression.
gui.draxatomic.skills.title: Skill Tree
gui.draxatomic.skills.keys: R cast · Z next spell · V (hold) compress · K this screen
message.draxatomic.awakening_full: You need a nearly full power bar to Awaken.
